titleKeywords.title: Role keywords
titleKeywords.description: Companies with open roles whose title contains one of these, e.g. "salesforce", "data engineer", "SDR". Short keywords (3 letters or fewer) match whole words only.

titleExcludeKeywords.title: Exclude title keywords
titleExcludeKeywords.description: Drop roles whose title contains any of these, e.g. "intern", "senior".

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Only count roles where any listed location (or the country) contains one of these, e.g. "United States", "Texas", "London".

remoteOnly.title: Remote roles only
remoteOnly.description: Only count roles whose location or workplace label says remote.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only count matching roles posted in the last N days, e.g. 30 for companies actively hiring for it now.

minMatchingJobs.title: Minimum matching roles
minMatchingJobs.description: Only companies with at least this many open roles matching your search.

minTotalOpenJobs.title: Minimum company openings
minTotalOpenJobs.description: Only companies with at least this many open roles in total (any role). A rough company-size filter.

maxTotalOpenJobs.title: Maximum company openings
maxTotalOpenJobs.description: Only companies with at most this many open roles in total, e.g. 300 to skip the giants and find mid-size companies.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Which companies come first. The maximum below keeps the top of this list.

companyKeywords.title: Companies
companyKeywords.description: Only companies whose name contains one of these, e.g. to check a list of target accounts.

sources.title: Career-site systems
sources.description: Limit to some systems. Leave empty for all.

onlyWithSalary.title: Only jobs that state pay
onlyWithSalary.description: Only count roles whose posting states pay.

minAnnualSalary.title: Minimum yearly pay
minAnnualSalary.description: Only count roles whose pay range reaches at least this much per year, in the job's own currency.

salaryCurrencies.title: Pay currencies
salaryCurrencies.description: Only roles paying in these currencies, e.g. "USD", "GBP", "EUR". Implies 'only jobs that state pay'.

maxRoleAgeDays.title: Ignore roles older than (days)
maxRoleAgeDays.description: Some career sites never take old ads down. Roles posted longer ago than this are left out of every count. Set 0 to keep everything.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only companies with new matching roles since last run
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: For scheduled runs: return only companies that posted a matching role since this same search last ran, i.e. fresh hiring signals. The Actor remembers each search in a key-value store named hiring-companies-monitor in your account; changing any filter starts a new history.

monitorName.title: Search name (optional)
monitorName.description: Only needed to keep two searches with identical filters separate, e.g. one per client.

maxCompanies.title: Maximum companies
maxCompanies.description: Hard cap on results, and your main cost control: you are charged per company returned. The top companies by the chosen sort come first.
